items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: And I don't know what part she played in that, but she, she did the major.

ctx.x: But anyway, okay. You have to look it up later.

So when I found out about this, you know, people called me and told me about it. What I did was went down to see him, I said, Marshall, you know, some sort of the case, I found out. And I, and I said, man, look, I need $200. Just, you know, cause really I was trying to find out. And he gave me $200. Because I told him I knew about what's happened with the record, and he gave me a check for $200 and the check bounced. But he made, they made it good about three weeks later, yeah. But you know, when a check bounced…
Do you think, do you think he owed you more than $200?
